name: ses-agent-desktop
description: Local-first SES workbench for macOS and Windows
author: SES Agent Desktop Team

scripts.test:privacy-quality-gate: npm run build:vision-ocr && node scripts/run-electron-tsx.mjs scripts/verify-privacy-quality-gate.ts
scripts.test:privacy-expert: npm run build:vision-ocr && node scripts/run-electron-tsx.mjs scripts/verify-privacy-expert-dataset.ts
scripts.predev: npm run test:privacy-quality-gate && npm run build:wechat-accessibility
scripts.build: npm run build:vision-ocr && npm run build:wechat-accessibility && npm run build:windows-ocr && npm run test:ui-localization && npm run test:docs-status && npm run typecheck && electron-vite build && node scripts/generate-cloud-enforcement-manifest.mjs
scripts.pack:mac:dir: npm run test:privacy-quality-gate && npm run test:google-workspace-contract && npm run build && npm run build:app-icon && electron-builder --mac dir --arm64 --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.pack:mac:unsigned: npm run test:privacy-quality-gate && npm run test:google-workspace-contract && npm run build && npm run build:app-icon && electron-builder --mac dmg --arm64 --config electron-builder.dev.yml
scripts.pack:mac:smoke: npm run pack:mac:dir && npm run test:package:mac
scripts.pack:win:dir: node scripts/check-windows-build-host.mjs && npm run test:privacy-quality-gate && npm run test:google-workspace-contract && npm run build && electron-builder --win dir --x64 --config electron-builder.win.dev.yml
scripts.pack:win:unsigned: node scripts/check-windows-build-host.mjs && npm run test:privacy-quality-gate && npm run test:google-workspace-contract && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.win.dev.yml
scripts.release:mac: npm run verify:embedding-model && npm run verify:reranker-model && npm run test:privacy-quality-gate && npm run test:google-workspace-contract && SES_WECHAT_RELEASE_REQUIRED=1 npm run test:wechat-gate && npm run build && npm run build:app-icon && npm run release:check:mac && electron-builder --mac dmg zip --arm64 --config electron-builder.yml && npm run test:dmg:mac -- --release --require-signature
scripts.release:win: npm run test:privacy-expert && npm run test:google-workspace-contract && npm run test:windows-ocr && npm run test:windows-local-workers && npm run pack:win:dir && npm run test:package:win -- --require-expert-report && npm run release:check:win && electron-builder --win nsis --x64 --config electron-builder.win.yml && npm run test:installer:win -- --require-signature
scripts.test:windows-ocr: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-tsx.mjs scripts/verify-windows-offline-ocr.ts
scripts.test:windows-local-workers: npm run build && node scripts/run-electron-tsx.mjs scripts/verify-windows-local-workers.ts
scripts.test:platform:win: npm run build:windows-ocr && node scripts/run-electron-tsx.mjs scripts/verify-windows-platform.ts
